Wood shield

Internal ID: ShieldWood | Type: Shield | Source: Workbench | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Resin x4, Leather scraps x4 | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Wood shield is the first round Shield. It has four less block power and 80 less block force compared to Wood tower shield but can be used to parry enemy attacks.

Upgrade information. The cost to max is 25 wood, 10 resin and 10 leather scraps.

Notes. • When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
